description.ja: コミックボンボンにて好評連載中の「武者○伝」に登場する號斗丸のパワーアップ「爆王頑駄無」がプラモデルで登場。
description.en: Gotomaru's power-up "Bakuo Gundam ", which appears in " Musha○den" which is currently being serialized in Comic Bonbon, is now available as a plastic model.

description.ja: 鎧パーツを組みかえて「DX形態」から「V2形態」に変形可能です。
description.en: Can be transformed from "DX form " to " V2 form" by rearranging armor parts.

description.ja: また、バックパックが分離して「ナイトファルコン形態」になります。
description.en: Also, the backpack separates and becomes "Night Falcon form".
